items.title: 4.1 Mustaqil force ka kiya kaam (work) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.1 with Figs. 4.1 to 4.4 (PDF 75-76).

blocks.text: Kaam (work) ko aksar jismani ya zehni mehnat ke mani mein socha jata hai. Physics mein albatta kaam ki istilah do cheezein shamil karti hai: (i) force aur (ii) displacement. Hum us saadi soorat se shuru karte hain jis mein kaam mustaqil force karti hai.

blocks.title: Mustaqil force ka kaam
blocks.text: Mustaqil force F se kheenchi jane wali cheez lein jo use force ki simt mein displacement d se hilati hai. Kaam W force F ki miqdar aur displacement d ki miqdar ke hasil-e-zarb ke taur par bayan hota hai: W = F d ... (4.1).

Equation 4.1 dikhati hai ke agar displacement sifr ho to bari force lagane par bhi koi kaam nahi hota: deewar ko dhakelna aap ke pathon ko thaka sakta hai, magar kiya gaya kaam sifr hai (Fig. 4.1). Jism par lagai force hamesha displacement ki simt mein nahi hoti (Fig. 4.2). Agar force F displacement d se zawiya theta banaye to kiya gaya kaam displacement ki simt mein force ke component aur displacement ki miqdar ke hasil-e-zarb ke barabar hai: W = (F cos theta) d = F d cos theta ... (4.2), ya W = F . d ... (4.3) (Fig. 4.3). Equation 4.3 dikhati hai ke kaam scalar quantity hai. Kaam ka unit joule (J) hai; Eq. 4.1 se 1 J = 1 N m.

blocks.alt: Aik shakhs aage jhuk kar dono haathon se deewar dhakelta hai; surkh teer deewar par force F dikhata hai. Deewar nahi hilti, aur note kehta hai d = 0, is liye W = F d cos theta = 0, chahe kitna bhi zor lagayein.
blocks.caption: Deewar dhakelta shakhs: force hai magar displacement nahi, is liye kaam nahi (Figure 4.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Jab mustaqil force faasle d tak lage to yeh waqea saade graph par bana ja sakta hai (Fig. 4.4), faasla x-axis par aur force y-axis par. Chunke force nahi badalti, graph ufqi seedhi lakeer hai. Agar mustaqil force F (newton) aur displacement d (metre) ek hi simt mein hon to kiya kaam F d (joule) hai; Fig. 4.4 ka rangeen raqba bhi F d hai, to force-displacement curve ke neeche ka raqba mustaqil force ke kiye kaam ko zahir karne ko liya ja sakta hai. Agar force displacement ki simt mein na ho to graph F cos theta aur d ke darmiyan banaya jata hai.

items: Agar theta 90 degrees se kam ho to kaam hota hai aur use musbat kaam kehte hain.
Agar theta = 90 degrees ho to koi kaam nahi hota.
Agar theta 90 degrees se zyada ho to kiye kaam ko manfi kehte hain.
Kaam ka SI unit N m hai, jo joule (J) kehlata hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: zawiya theta par force se displacement d tak kheencha block, component F cos theta aur raqbe F d wala force-displacement mustateel. Oopar darmiyan: P se Q tak displacement ke muqable F cos theta ka curve pattiyon mein bata hua, jis ke neeche ka raqba kaam hai. Oopar daen: gravitational field mein A se B tak raste 1, 2 aur 3 oonchai h ke saath. Neeche: non-conservative forces, Example 4.1, power ke formulas, kilowatt-hour, Example 4.2 aur taqreebi powers ki table.
blocks.caption: Mustaqil aur badalti force ka kaam, conservative forces, aur power (Figures 4.1 se 4.10 aur topics 4.1 se 4.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Kaam displacement ke saath force ke component aur displacement ka hasil-e-zarb hai, to harkat par amood force ya baghair displacement ki force koi kaam nahi karti, aur harkat ki mukhalif force manfi kaam karti hai; force-displacement graph par mustaqil force mustateel deti hai jis ka raqba kaam hai. Jab force badle to rasta chhote wuqfon mein kata jata hai jin mein force taqreeban mustaqil hai, har ek mein kaam force ka component zarb wuqfa hai, aur wuqfon ke sifr ki taraf jane ki had mein kul kaam displacement ke muqable force ke component ke curve ke neeche ka raqba hai. Gravity do nuqton ke darmiyan rasta koi bhi ho wahi kaam manfi mgh karti hai, aur band raste par sifr, jo use conservative force banata hai, raghrat ke baraks, jis ka kaam raste ki lambai se barhta hai. Power kaam karne ki raftar hai, force zarb velocity ke barabar, watts mein napi hui, bijli ki energy ka tijarti unit kilowatt-hour.

blocks.caption: Kaam ka nishan
header: F aur d ke darmiyan zawiya theta

blocks.prompt: Musafir farsh se 45 degrees par strap par 200 N force se suitcase 50 m ghaseet-ta hai; kiya kaam nikalein (numerical problem 4.8). Jism 5 N force ke tahat 10 m chalta hai aur kiya kaam 25 J hai; zawiya kya hai (MCQ 4.10)?
blocks.explanation: W = F d cos theta = 200 x 50 x cos 45 = 200 x 50 x 0.707 = 7071 J, taqreeban 7 kJ. 25 = 5 x 10 x cos theta se cos theta = 0.5, to theta = 60 degrees.

items: Kaam ko force aur displacement chahiye: W = F d; zawiye par W = F d cos theta = F . d; joules mein scalar (1 J = 1 N m); displacement nahi to kaam nahi (deewar dhakelna).
90 degrees se neeche musbat, 90 par sifr, oopar manfi; force-displacement graph par lakeer ke neeche raqba kaam hai.
